notes.title: Minor user experience update
notes.notes:
- Esc added as permanent Pause key in game, the player can change the other pause key bind in the settings menu, the default key is P. 
- Fixed the button size in the controllers and keyboard settings menu

notes.title: Important Update
notes.notes:
Added in game settings menu, now you can change the settings.
Added a plugin to compile shaders before the game starts to avoid shutters.

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.notes: Fixed the direction button on Game Pads in the Level 3 (bridges control)

notes.title: First Update after release
notes.notes:
- Several bug fixes
- Level 4 added background city
- Level 4 added final airplane animation
- Enemy AI improvement 
- Character aim improvement 
- Character stamina and life adjusts
- General Texture optimization
